note: Promotion to the tracked schema (v0.94.0, prompt 3 tranche five). Each theme in this pack names rows spanning only some of the five bands — a sliding, sometimes wrap-around window of three or four — not all five (the original bands mechanism) and not exactly one (unbanded). "partial_bands": true fills each row's empty description from its theme's own per-grade sentence, authored only for the grades that theme actually has. track/code are not filled by this promotion (see tools/normalize_blocks.py apply_promotions): this pack's natural sub-groupings do not form the 50-block tracked shape. Theme text, grouping and grade spans are copied verbatim from data/blocks.csv; nothing else is touched.
